bull_points.claim: The stock fell ~60% over 180 days versus the mid-cap benchmark up ~12%, a ~72pp idiosyncratic underperformance far exceeding any operational deterioration, consistent with an overshoot rather than a broken business.

Absolute EBITDA is still rising — $707M FY25 → $731M LTM Mar-2026 — even as the EBITDA margin % compressed to 13%, so the trailing-margin decline overstates deterioration; the absolute reconciler is the real signal here and it is up.

decisive_question.question: Is the sharp de-rating an overshoot on a still-growing, net-cash franchise (mean-revert), or an earned repricing to a permanently lower-growth, lower-margin AI-disrupted services model (value trap)?

evidence_for.claim: Revenue still grew +7.6% YoY in Q1 and absolute EBITDA rose to $731M LTM, with pure-AI revenue up ~20% sequentially toward a $600M target — an operating base inconsistent with terminal decline.

evidence_against.claim: Management flagged North America underperformance, rising macro uncertainty and lower second-half visibility with expected Q2 impact on discretionary programs — the demand mechanism that could make lower growth durable.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ transcript: EPAM Systems, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf

evidence_against.claim: Estimate breadth is one-sided down (FY26 revenue 0 up/6 down, EPS 0 up/4 down last month) and multi-year gross margin has fallen from 36% to 29%, signalling an earned, not optical, decline.

key_unknowns: Adjusted/forward EBITDA and adjusted EPS in the revised guidance are UNKNOWN, so a clean forward multiple and forward leverage cannot be built — a disclosure gap that weakens the cheap-vs-terminal test.

Segment EBITDA is not disclosed (only Americas/Europe revenue), so the profitability mix behind the North America weakness and the margin compression cannot be isolated — an opacity risk that should be read cautiously, not neutrally.
Interest coverage is UNKNOWN (no period with both EBITDA and interest expense), though net-cash status makes this less load-bearing.

The primary-source cross-check flags a MISMATCH between the CIQ revenue guide (1,400–1,415) and the release outlook (4.0–6.5% growth), and self-funding reads MIXED (latest-Q OCF negative while LTM FCF positive) — both need reconciliation before leaning on the self-funding thesis.
The peer set is HETEROGENEOUS (market caps $953M–$100.8B, 106x span), so the peer median is not a clean benchmark and any earned-vs-residual discount read is confidence-gated.
Whether the tokenomics/AI-pricing shift management describes is margin-accretive or margin-dilutive over time is unresolved — the commercial-model transition could cut either way.

Data vintage is a floor (≥2026-07-27, export date unverified) against a stock price of $100.4 as-of 2026-07-28 that has recovered off the ~$42 June low — the current setup may already differ from the trailing series.

business_description.value: EPAM Systems, Inc. provides digital platform engineering and software development services worldwide. The company offers engineering services, including requirements analysis and platform selection, customization, cross-platform migration, implementation, and integration; cloud services for creating a roadmap to set and refine IT and business goals while identifying new and emerging opportunities leveraging cloud technologies; data, analytics and artificial intelligence; customer experience; marketing; and cybersecurity. It also offers operation solutions comprising integrated engineering practices and smart automation services. In addition, the company offers software product and platform development services, which comprise product research, customer experience design and prototyping, program management, component design and integration, full lifecycle software testing, product deployment and end-user customization, performance tuning, product support and maintenance, managed services, as well as cross-platform migration and modernizing legacy platforms. The company serves the financial services; consumer goods, retail and travel; software and Hi-tech; business information and media, life sciences and healthcare; and emerging verticals industries EPAM Systems, Inc. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Newtown, Pennsylvania.
